info.name: Tea-It-Up Backend API
info.description:
Golf tee-time booking platform API (Express + MongoDB/Mongoose).

Base URL: {{serverUrl}}, mounted API prefix: {{baseUrl}} = {{serverUrl}}/api/v1.

Auth: Bearer access token in the Authorization header (collection-level auth uses {{accessToken}}, auto-captured by the Register/Login requests' test scripts). The refresh token is a separate httpOnly, signed cookie — enable Postman's cookie jar for /auth/refresh-token and /auth/logout.

Suggested run order for a full happy path: Health Check -> Register (or Login as SUPER_ADMIN seeded via SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD) -> Admin: Create Club -> Login as the new course manager -> Admin: Approve Club -> Bulk Create Tee Times -> Create Booking -> Confirm Booking -> Record Payment.

Roles (see user.constant.ts): SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, COURSE_MANAGER, STAFF, USER.

variable.description: Human-readable booking reference (e.g. TIU-88291-ZX), used for guest lookup

item.name: Health & Root
item.description: Endpoints mounted outside /api/v1 directly on the Express app.

request.description: Renders the server landing page HTML (app.ts root route). Not a JSON API endpoint.
Returns { success, statusCode, message, data: { uptime } }. Use to verify the API is up before running the rest of the collection.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token refresh, password reset, and session management. Refresh token is an httpOnly signed cookie (REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE) — enable Postman's cookie jar for /auth/refresh-token and /auth/logout to work.

request.description: Creates a USER account. Sets the refresh token cookie and returns an access token.
Logs in any role (USER, COURSE_MANAGER, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN). Use the matching account credentials for the role you want to test.

Reads the signed httpOnly refresh-token cookie set by Register/Login and issues a new access token + rotated refresh cookie. Requires Postman cookie jar (automatic in Postman desktop/web when cookies are enabled for localhost).
Revokes the current refresh token (from cookie) and clears the cookie.
Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists. Sends an OTP to the email if an account exists.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP sent via Forgot Password and returns a one-time resetTicket for Reset Password.
Consumes the resetTicket from Verify OTP to set a new password.
Requires Bearer access token. Also the one route exempted from the "must reset temporary password" guard, so admin-provisioned accounts can call this first.
Lists active refresh-token sessions (device/IP/user-agent) for the authenticated user.
Revokes a specific session by id (log out a specific device).

item.name: Golf Courses
item.description: Public course browsing plus ADMIN onboarding and COURSE_MANAGER self-editing.

request.description: Only APPROVED courses are returned. No auth required — backs explore-clubs on the website.

Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Includes courses in every status, not just APPROVED.

Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Creates a new COURSE_MANAGER account plus a PENDING course in one request — backs AllClubs.tsx's "Create New Club" modal. The manager must change their temporary password on first login.
Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Moves a PENDING course to APPROVED; isFeatured is optional.
Requires COURSE_MANAGER role. Returns the course owned by the authenticated manager.
Requires COURSE_MANAGER role. Every field is optional — backs EditClub.tsx in full. Image fields take Media _ids (see Media folder for upload).

item.name: Tee Times
item.description: Slot management for COURSE_MANAGER, read access for ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.

request.description: COURSE_MANAGER sees only their own course's slots; ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN see every course's slots.

Requires COURSE_MANAGER role. One date per schedule, multiple {from, to} slot pairs per schedule — matches AddTeaTime.tsx's nested field-array shape. bookingType: INSTANT | SHARED_CART | MEMBER_ONLY (optional).
Requires COURSE_MANAGER role (must own the slot's course). All fields optional.
Requires COURSE_MANAGER role (must own the slot's course).
